messages:
priya: quick heads-up — ran parity bench for same-SKU (A100-40GB equiv) across AWS eu-west-1, GCP europe-west4, Azure westeurope. driver 525.60 + CUDA 11.8 on all images. Observed ~15% p99 latency bump on GCP and a 12% token throughput drop on Azure when using q4_k_m int8 quant. CSV + logs uploaded: https://s3.redwood/bench/1818501234.csv :chart_with_upwards_trend:

samir: can you paste exact driver/cudnn/kernel? also were any BIOS/firmware updates recently applied?

priya: kernel: 5.15.0-101-generic on all clouds. nvidia-driver 525.60.11, cudnn 8.6.0. quant: q4_k_m (nf4-like) int8, dynamic batcher target=8. image build and batcher config identical. link: https://s3.redwood/bench/1818501234.csv

ops-bot: deploy-batch job benchmark-runner/2026-05-03-18:20 completed (artifacts: s3://bench/1818501234)

eli: @priya were these single-GPU tests or MIG slices? Azure has been exposing different defaults lately.

priya: single GPU, no MIG. tried enabling persistent-kernel and cuBLASLt heuristics — that helped AWS p99 by ~6% but GCP still ~10% worse.

samir: can you paste the nvidia-smi and CUDA version check you ran? e.g. run: ```nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,cuda_version --format=csv```

priya: output from each cloud (trimmed):
```
AWS: Driver Version, CUDA Version
525.60.11, 11.8
GCP: 525.60.11, 11.8
Azure: 535.54.03, 12.1
```

eli: hmmm Azure using 535/CUDA12.1 could explain q4_k_m regression. also check PCIe gen / bios. GCP recently rolled a custom image — maybe kernel config differs (I/O / RAS flags). run `lspci -vvv | grep -i pcie`

priya: confirmed: GCP image had an intel PCIe RAS module enabled that adds error checking; disabling that removed the p99 gap in a quick re-run. Azure: rolling back to driver 525 + CUDA 11.8 removed the throughput drop for quantized kernels.

samir: so root causes: (1) kernel/firmware PCIe settings on GCP causing latency tail, (2) newer driver/CUDA combo on Azure interacting poorly with our int8 kernel path. Action items: pin driver 525 + CUDA 11.8 for production quantized flows, add a preflight image check to model onboarding that runs kernel/kernel-module + driver smoke tests.

priya: adding to model-onboarding checklist: run `quant-kernel-smoke` across aws/gcp/azure, collect p50/p95/p99 + tok/s, block rollout if >10% cross-cloud variance. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4023

ops-bot: created ticket INF-2246: "cross-cloud quant kernel smoke test" (owner: infra)

eli: :thumbsup: I'll pick up the preflight hook for the infra image pipeline and add the `lspci` + driver checks as gating steps.

priya: thanks — I'll update the onboarding docs with repro steps and attach the full logs.
